cards.name: Hisuian Voltorb
cards.notes: Hisuian Voltorb from Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery GG01/GG70 is included in this guide as a sleepy Pokemon card for collectors building a calm, cozy, or nap-themed binder. As a Trainer Gallery Rare Holo, it connects nicely with the characterful, scene-driven side of modern Pokemon card collecting. The card is illustrated by HYOGONOSUKE, which is useful context for collectors who like arranging pages by artist as well as by Pokemon. Its approachable market price makes it a strong budget pick for building out a sleepy Pokemon binder page. It works nicely in a Sword & Shield-era page, especially alongside Trainer Gallery and alternate-art sleepy cards.
cards.whyItBelongs: Cozy nap nestled into ancient forest roots. Hyogonosuke turns the wooden Pokéball Pokémon into a blissful woodland seed.
